a1-36.title: Communicative Challenge: Where Are the Books?
a1-36.scenario: Károly is looking for the books and the tables and asks Meg where they are.
a1-36.prompt: Tell Károly that the books are here and the tables are there.
a1-36.target: A könyvek itt vannak. Az asztalok ott vannak.
a1-36.english: The books are here. The tables are there.
a1-36.canDo: I can make a Hungarian noun plural with -k.
